name: divya-patel-portfolio
description: Portfolio of Divya Patel, Backend & Cloud Engineer. Static site: HTML + Tailwind CSS + vanilla JavaScript.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run csp && npm run sections
scripts.dev: npm run build && (npm run build:css -- --watch & npx esbuild src/js/main.js --bundle --format=esm --splitting --target=es2020 --outdir=public/assets/js --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --watch & wait)
